Visitor wraps figure content with custom formatting

```java title="Java"
import io.xberg.htmltomarkdown.*;

public final class Example {
    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
        class _TestVisitor implements HtmlVisitor {
            @Override public VisitResult visitFigureEnd(NodeContext ctx, String output) {
                return new VisitResult.Custom(String.format("%s\n[/FIGURE]\n", output));
            }
            @Override public VisitResult visitFigureStart(NodeContext ctx) {
                return new VisitResult.Custom("\n[FIGURE]\n");
            }
        }
        var visitor = new _TestVisitor();
        var result = HtmlToMarkdownRs.convert("<section><h2>Gallery</h2><figure><img src=\"photo1.jpg\" alt=\"Photo\"><figcaption>Beautiful sunset</figcaption></figure></section>", ConversionOptions.builder().withVisitor(visitor).build());
        System.out.println(result.content());
    }
}
```
